issues: ExportScreen fails to render the "Export CSV" button or handle its click, causing the UI primary flow to time out when trying to click "Export CSV". The current implementation imports expo-file-system and expo-sharing at the top level, which crashes on the web build, and treats CSV data as Base64, leading to runtime errors and preventing the success message "Report ready to share." from appearing. Update expo-app/src/screens/ExportScreen.tsx to lazily import expo-file-system and expo-sharing inside the async handler, guard the code with Platform.OS checks, write CSV data using UTF‑8 encoding (not Base64), and handle PDF data appropriately (convert ArrayBuffer to Base64 before writing). Ensure the button’s onPress always sets the success message after a successful request, so the UI flow can find the "Export CSV" button and see the expected toast text.
feedback: Fix the ExportScreen implementation as described to ensure the Export CSV button works on both native and web platforms and displays the expected success message. This will resolve the failed UI primary flow test.
